description: This file defines the 'CurrentUserAccessor' class, which implements the 'ICurrentUserAccessor' interface. It provides a method to retrieve the current username based on the HTTP context's user claims.

classes.name: CurrentUserAccessor
classes.description: A class that accesses the current user's information via IHttpContextAccessor.

methods.name: GetCurrentUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username of the current user from the HTTP context's claims, if available.
